queries.Load: TITLE-ABS-KEY((("electricity" OR "power") W/3 ("load" OR "demand")) W/3 (forecast* OR predict*)) AND PUBYEAR > 2009 AND PUBYEAR < 2027 AND DOCTYPE(ar OR re)
queries.Price: TITLE-ABS-KEY((("electricity" OR "power") W/3 "price") W/3 (forecast* OR predict*)) AND PUBYEAR > 2009 AND PUBYEAR < 2027 AND DOCTYPE(ar OR re)
queries.Wind: TITLE-ABS-KEY((("wind" W/3 ("power" OR "generation")) W/3 (forecast* OR predict*))) AND PUBYEAR > 2009 AND PUBYEAR < 2027 AND DOCTYPE(ar OR re)
queries.Solar: TITLE-ABS-KEY(((("solar" OR "photovoltaic" OR "PV") W/3 ("power" OR "generation")) W/3 (forecast* OR predict*))) AND PUBYEAR > 2009 AND PUBYEAR < 2027 AND DOCTYPE(ar OR re)
